item.title: National guidance puts child safety at centre of ECEC building design
item.description: New national guidance is calling for child safety, effective supervision and children’s rights to be considered from the earliest stages of education and care service design, with practical examples showing how the physical environment can reduce risks to children.

item.description: Redirection is one of eight practical strategies being highlighted by the Queensland Department of Education to help new and emerging early childhood educators positively guide children’s behaviour and strengthen everyday practice.

item.title: Australia begins consultation on next action plans for Safe and Supported
item.description: Early childhood organisations, researchers and other stakeholders have an opportunity to contribute to the next stage of Australia’s national framework for protecting children, with targeted engagement underway to inform the Second Action Plans for Safe and Supported from 2027 to 2031.

item.title: Screen time not consistently linked to poorer development, decade-long study finds
item.description: Screen use alone may not be a reliable predictor of children’s emotional, behavioural and social development, with a decade-long study finding few consistent associations between time spent on screens and poorer psychosocial outcomes.

item.description: Children who attended public school pre-K recorded stronger academic results than those who experienced other forms of early childhood care, with a large US study finding differences that persisted through high school.

item.title: Goodstarters discover next practice on international study tour
